nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances in ERC20; holds token balances of every account.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; nested allowance map owner=>spender=>amount.
uint256 private _totalSupply; total minted token supply, initialised to 0 in constructor.
string private _name; token name set to 'Red Tazz' in constructor.
string private _symbol; token symbol set to 'RTZ' in constructor.
address private _owner in Ownable; privileged owner used by onlyOwner modifier.
bool private _paused in Pausable; gates transfer/approve/mint via whenNotPaused.
msg.sender as returned by Context._msgSender(); attacker controllable caller identity.
Context._msgSender() internal view virtual returns (address); returns msg.sender.
ERC20.transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public whenNotPaused; delegates to _transfer from _msgSender().
ERC20.transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public whenNotPaused; moves tokens, then decrements allowance and re-approves.
ERC20.approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public whenNotPaused; sets allowance for _msgSender().
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public whenNotPaused; performs raw uint256 addition on allowance.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public whenNotPaused; checks and subtracts allowance.
ERC20.mint(address recepient, uint amount) external onlyOwner whenNotPaused; privileged supply inflation entry point.
ERC20._transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal virtual; core balance mutation logic.
ERC20._mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual; increases _totalSupply and _balances.
ERC20._approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal virtual; writes _allowances.
ERC20.balanceOf(address account) public view; reads _balances.
ERC20.pay() public payable {} unguarded ether-receiving function present in the deployed token.
Ownable.owner() public view virtual returns (address); returns _owner, used by onlyOwner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership() public virtual onlyOwner; sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) public virtual onlyOwner; transfers privileged ownership.
Pausable.pause() public virtual whenNotPaused onlyOwner; sets _paused = true.
Pausable.unpause() public virtual whenPaused onlyOwner; sets _paused = false.
Raw uint256 addition `_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue` in increaseAllowance, bypassing SafeMath; arithmetic hazard.
Unguarded payable fallback-like entry point pay() that accepts arbitrary ether with no accounting, no event and no withdrawal path.
Allowance decrement performed through SafeMath.sub in transferFrom and decreaseAllowance and written back to _allowances; arithmetic-sensitive state update.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender().
_msgSender() supplies the sender account used by transfer().
_msgSender() supplies the spender identity used for the allowance lookup in transferFrom().
_msgSender() is the owner argument passed to _approve() by approve().
_msgSender() indexes _allowances in increaseAllowance().
_msgSender() indexes _allowances in decreaseAllowance().
mint() is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender(); privileged caller-controlled path.
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner check is evaluated against _msgSender().
transferOwnership() onlyOwner check is evaluated against _msgSender().
pause() is guarded by onlyOwner which tests _msgSender().
unpause() is guarded by onlyOwner which tests _msgSender().
transfer() calls the internal _transfer() to move balances.
transferFrom() calls _transfer() before touching the allowance.
transferFrom() re-approves the reduced allowance through _approve().
approve() writes the allowance via _approve().
increaseAllowance() stores the new allowance via _approve().
decreaseAllowance() stores the reduced allowance via _approve().
mint() calls the internal _mint() supply inflation routine.
addedValue flows into the raw uint256 addition performed inside increaseAllowance().
amount flows into the SafeMath allowance subtraction performed in transferFrom().
subtractedValue flows into the SafeMath allowance subtraction performed in decreaseAllowance().
The unchecked sum is written into the _allowances mapping via _approve().
The reduced allowance value is written back into the _allowances mapping.
_transfer() subtracts from the sender balance and adds to the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint() credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint() increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_approve() writes the nested _allowances mapping.
balanceOf() reads balances from the _balances mapping.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership() overwrites the privileged _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership() zeroes the privileged _owner state variable.
pause() flips the _paused state variable to true.
unpause() flips the _paused state variable back to false.
pay() is payable and causes unguarded ether reception handled by the unsafe payable operation.
recipient parameter of transfer() flows into _transfer().
amount parameter of transfer() drives the balance subtraction/addition arithmetic.
sender parameter of transferFrom() is used for the allowance lookup and _transfer().
recipient parameter of transferFrom() flows into _transfer().
amount parameter of transferFrom() drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
spender parameter of approve() becomes the allowance key.
amount parameter of approve() is stored as the new allowance.
spender parameter of increaseAllowance() indexes _allowances.
addedValue parameter is the addend of the unchecked allowance addition.
spender parameter of decreaseAllowance() indexes _allowances.
subtractedValue parameter is the subtrahend of the allowance subtraction.
recepient parameter of the owner-only mint() determines who receives newly minted supply.
amount parameter of mint() is checked >0 and added to total supply.
sender parameter of _transfer() is debited in _balances.
recipient parameter of _transfer() is credited in _balances.
amount parameter of _transfer() is subtracted from senderBalance and added to the recipient.
account parameter of _mint() receives the minted balance.
amount parameter of _mint() is added to _totalSupply and _balances.
owner parameter of _approve() is the outer key of _allowances.
spender parameter of _approve() is the inner key of _allowances.
amount parameter of _approve() is the value written into _allowances.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership() is written into the privileged _owner state variable.
currentAllowance local caches and then holds the decremented allowance inside transferFrom().
currentAllowance local caches and then holds the decremented allowance inside decreaseAllowance().
senderBalance local is the working copy of the sender balance inside _transfer().
